correctness.rationale: Stationary resetting resolvent π_r(f)=r∫exp(-rt)(P_t f)(S)dt follows from memoryless independent reset and irreducibility. r→0 yields uniform k-subset moments and C= -k(n-k)/(n²(n-1)). At high r use U=1-η_x,V=1-η_y. Their first departure derivatives are d_x,d_y; exactly two jumps to distinct initial empty neighbors give second Taylor coefficient d_x d_y-c and no other two-jump routes end with both x,y vacant. Exponential-age integrals multiply by 2!, giving r² Cov(U,V)=d_xd_y-2c. Explicit three-state generator on K_(2,m) has rates 0->1:4, 1->0:m-1, 1->2:1, 2->1:2m and reset 0,1->2:r. Solving π gives C=m((m-2)r-4)/((m+r+2)^2(2m+r+2)), yielding exactly one positive root r=4/(m-2) iff m>=3. Four-cycle specialization and even-block boundary coefficient follow. Independent symbolic rational generator calculation reproduced the K_(2,m) formula; limit claims fixed graph.
